# Australian radio station table

`stations.csv` is the source for `main/apps/radio/au_radio_table_data.inc`,
generated by `tools/generate_radio_table.py` (`--check` runs in host tests).

The file holds only the header row for now. Rows will come from the ACMA
licensed transmitter list (Creative Commons Attribution, credit ACMA) in a later
step. Do not add stations by hand.

Columns: area_id, area_name, state (AU abbreviation), lat, lon, band (FM, AM or
DAB), freq (FM in 0.1 MHz, AM in kHz, DAB 0), dab_block (DAB only), name,
query (radio-browser name search used to resolve the stream on tune).
